cards.title: Movement prepositions
cards.body: Direction and path — not only place (where something is).
cards.body_cz: Směr a cesta — ne jen místo (kde něco je).
points: to = general goal · into = enter inside
onto = movement onto a surface · on = place (static)

cards.title: Path
cards.body: Picture the line of movement across, along, through…
cards.body_cz: Představ si čáru pohybu: přes, podél, skrz…

table.caption: path
rows: over the bridge · under the bridge
up the stairs · down the hill

cards.title: Transport chunks
cards.body: Learn get on / get off as fixed phrases with bus, tram, train.
cards.body_cz: Nauč se get on / get off jako celek s bus, tram, train.

cards.title: in / on vs into / onto
cards.body: in / on = place (static). into / onto = movement into / onto.
cards.body_cz: in / on = místo (statické). into / onto = pohyb dovnitř / na povrch.

cards.title: More path preps
cards.body: More path shapes: around, between, towards.
cards.body_cz: Další tvary cesty: around (kolem), between (mezi), towards (směrem k).

cards.title: Practice focus
cards.body: The gap is the preposition. Think: direction, enter, exit, or path?
cards.body_cz: Doplňuješ předložku. Mysli: směr, dovnitř, ven, nebo cesta?
points: to vs into · on vs onto

cards.title: Remember
cards.body: to / into / onto / from / out of · path: across, along, through, past · transport: get on / off.
cards.body_cz: směr: to/into/from/out of · cesta: across/through/along · doprava: get on/off
points: to / into / onto / from / out of
get on / get off the bus
